speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The court rolls, Master Shakespeare, in a row, and the pen wiped. After this pass, by your own word of the twenty-sixth, nothing changes unless the playing itself is at fault.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One fault, Humphrey. A cue in the vault that two men heard differently yesterday. The book heard the cressets already up. The player heard the fire when he says light. I am keeping his.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Say it so the copy can hear it. I am not here to admire the choice.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then light them when he says light, and not before. Strike the other hearing. The margin was a quarrel. The roll is not allowed a quarrel.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Struck. Fire on the word. I have it on his roll and on mine. A book can keep one morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There were two more that I liked. A better word for the Friar, where he tells the living what they already fear. And a turn in the Nurse's lament, which would please me and cost the yard nothing it can name.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The ink is ready, sir, if you are going to write them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not. Liking a change is not a fault in the playing. Put the pen down, Sam. I am putting mine down.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: You have obeyed the rule that is mostly applied to boys. I thought I should say it while the ink was still in my hand, because no one else is going to.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The thumb-biting stays out. Two hours and a half for her Majesty, as Garnish has it. The Shoreditch length was two hours and fifty, and that is a different paper. We proceed. I have nothing to add to a man who has already stopped.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Then the rolls can lie in a row and be seen to agree. Each with the small sign in the corner, so a tireman in a hurry does not hand Romeo the Nurse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is carrier day. Four lines go down to the Bell, with the letter of the sixteenth and the six I wrote on the twenty-fourth. The six are not written again. The letter is not opened to be improved. The four lines are only this: the lovers are played on Saturday.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Send them by the boy. You are not walking to Carter Lane between a copy and a king. Richard is at two. The cut book. You know which scenes are not in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know. The boy can carry a tying. I will hear the line read back when the play is done, and I will not hear it improved.

speaker: (Larkham's boy)
text: I'll take them, sir. Three pieces, one wrapper. I can say it back if you want it said twice before I go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough. The lovers are played on Saturday. If you drop the wrapper, you do not invent a better sentence on the way.

speaker: (Larkham's boy)
text: The lovers are played on Saturday. I have the old letter and the six. I am not reading them.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Go. The Bell knows you. Master Hobbins writes a thing into his list before he believes it. That is his trouble, not yours.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Shall I sand the Friar, sir, so the better word cannot creep back while you are looking at a king?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sand it. The word I liked can die in the sand. Sam, you were right about the rule, and I am not going to thank you in a speech. Thanking it would be another change.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. The benefit of stopping is plain to the room, which is why I am not going to describe it. Humphrey, the row. Will, the king at two. The boy is already late if he listens to us any longer.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The row is what it is. One fault mended. Two left on the table, and the table does not get them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are done with Romeo until the yard. Dick may still dislike the end of him. Dislike is not a fault in the copy.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Dislike can wait in Holywell. The roll cannot. I have wiped the pen twice, which is as much ceremony as a copy gets.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: The sand is on the Friar. The better word is under it. I will not fish it out.
